text: Universities should prioritise open-access publishing to democratise knowledge. Paywalled journals systematically exclude researchers in lower-income countries. In 2023 my lab spent £4,200 on article processing charges for two short papers. Epistemic injustice concentrates citation capital among well-funded centres. When I tried to download a methods paper last semester the publisher blocked campus VPN access. Therefore institutions must treat APC budgets as equity infrastructure rather than discretionary spend.
